basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur has invited online applications for the following assignment in a purely time bound research project undertaken in the Department of G.S Sanyal School of Telecommunication of this institute. The position is available for the 6G Research and Standardization project sponsored by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (Government of India) (Electronics Niketan, 6, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi - 110003), with a consolidated compensation of up to 65000 per month.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential qualifications, age limits, and desired experience criteria prescribed for the project. 1) Essential Qualification : M.Tech / ME or equivalent degree OR B.Tech / BE or equivalent degree with 2 years of relevant experience. Desired Experience : M.Tech/ME/MS in Communication or Network specialization OR B.Tech/BE in ECE, ETC discipline with relevant experience as mentioned above. Strong fundamental knowledge in any one of the following: A. Digital Communication, Digital Signal Processing, Wireless Communication/ Optical Communicaction B. Wireless/ Optical Networks, Computer Network Knowledge in Probability, random process and Linear Algebra Good knowledge in MATLAB or C/C++ or Python Minimum 60% marks throughout the academic career. Age Limit : 35 years. Age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules if any.
